items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart suffered sprained MCL on MNF; X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday; expected to miss some time, positive overall. Ruled out mid-game.
items.why: Knee injury during game vs Rams; initial exams confirm MCL sprain.
items.implication: Jameis Winston elevated; Giants offense limited short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps; potential RB/pass-catcher volume shifts if scheme changes

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. Najee Harris active for Giants debut.
items.implication: Rams WR targets redistribute; Adams primary, depth WRs/TEs elevated.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Adams, Ferguson, Mumpfield, Parkinson

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce out several weeks rehabbing aggravated heel (prior surgery); IR likely, midseason return possible if no further surgery.
items.why: Aggravated surgically repaired heel; rehab preferred over immediate surgery.
items.implication: WR depth chart opens; Keenan Allen or others benefit.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered MCL sprain; likely out few weeks. Team re-signed Zach Ertz to PS with intent to promote.
items.why: Knee injury Week 2 vs Titans; confirmed sprain.
items.implication: TE targets open; Ertz/Mundt/Wicks elevated short-term.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams week-to-week right hamstring; avoided major injury per MRI, won't practice this week but not ruled out for Week 3 MNF vs Eagles. Bagent backup.
items.why: Non-contact scramble pull; positive MRI, coach optimistic on recovery speed.
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible sit Week 3 precaution.
items.opportunity: Bagent if out; Bears skill players docked if backup

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow (repeat); X-rays negative, imaging/specialists ongoing; miss significant/Week 3+ time, Mariota starts. Surgery possible.
items.why: Freak stumble/brace fall vs Cowboys; same elbow as prior dislocation.
items.implication: Mariota QB1 short-term; Commanders offense downgraded.
items.opportunity: Backup QB; potential skill player volume if more pass-heavy or checkdowns

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket). RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); grab Jonah Coleman.
items.why: Optimism confirmed for McConkey; Harvey not expected/out.
items.implication: McConkey playable with docks; Coleman stash/handcuff elevated.
items.opportunity: McConkey routes; Coleman carries/snaps behind Harvey

items.text: Week 2 GTD/OUT summary: McConkey optimism (flak), Nacua GTD, Harvey not expected, Olave/Burrow expected, Flowers/Pittman OUT. Later Nacua inactive confirmed.
items.implication: Clear start/sit signals; Flowers/Pittman handcuffs up.
items.opportunity: Bateman etc for Flowers; Bernard for Pittman

items.text: Saints: Etienne big FA deal but Week 2 Kendre Miller healthy scratch; Kamara 15 opps vs Etienne 11. Kamara inefficient (1.7 YPC, 1.4 YPR).
items.why: Despite contract, Etienne secondary; Miller scratched.
items.implication: Kamara lead back short-term despite poor efficiency; Etienne stash only.
items.conflict: Contract implied bigger role for Etienne

items.text: Kyren Williams 7 inside-20 opps this season, Blake Corum 0 (vs 60-27 last year). Clear RZ/goal-line monopoly.
items.why: Early season red-zone data shows total control.
items.implication: Kyren locked as every-down/RZ back; Corum irrelevant.

items.text: With Nacua out MNF: on 33 Stafford dropbacks - Adams 27 routes, Terrance Ferguson 23, Konata Mumpfield 21, Xavier Smith 19, Parkinson/Atwell 10.
items.implication: Adams WR1 locked; depth pieces (Ferguson/Mumpfield/Parkinson) viable pivots/flex.

items.text: Giants RBs MNF (Nacua out context): Cam Skattebo 34 snaps/16 opps lead; Singletary 15/4; Najee Harris 8/4. Tracy ST only.
items.why: Clear snap/opportunity lead with all RBs active.
items.implication: Skattebo emerging lead back; roster priority.

items.text: Puka out: anyone's guess attack. Prefer Parkinson flex pivot; else Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpfield at WR.
items.implication: Stream depth Rams pass-catchers in flex.
items.conflict: Levitan data favors Ferguson over some named

items.text: DeVonta Smith ride-or-die: 27%/38% target shares first two games; leads WRs in expected PPR points per Late Round model.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points early.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2; hold through any noise.
